summary: Re-verification of iteration 5 language-stickiness bug fix. detect_lang() was rewritten to return 'ar' when the message contains any Arabic-block codepoint, 'en' when it contains Latin letters only, and '' when the message has no linguistic signal (digits, emoji, technical tokens like 'add:<uuid>'). Both callers — POST /api/whatsapp/message (lines 627-632) and run_bot_for_whatsapp for the Meta webhook path (lines 874-879) — now only overwrite session['lang'] when detected=='ar' OR (detected=='en' AND the message is one of GREET_EN|CHECKOUT_EN|CONFIRM_EN|CANCEL_EN). Otherwise the previously-stored session lang is preserved. Ran the full backend pytest suite (2 parallel workers): **53/53 PASSED in 8.59s** — including the two previously-failing tests TestArabicOrderFlow::test_full_arabic_order_flow (full مرحبا → add:<id> → طلب → نعم flow stays Arabic all the way to 'تم تأكيد طلبك' with payload.type='receipt' and payload.whatsapp_dispatch present) and TestLangStickiness::test_add_after_arabic_greet_stays_arabic. English stickiness (TestEnglishOrderFlow::test_full_english_order_flow) is also green — 'Hi' → 'add:<id>' returns 'Added' (English) not 'تم إضافة' (Arabic). All 36 pre-existing regression tests remain green, all 15 bilingual/webhook tests from iteration 5 remain green.

Pre-existing: test_backend_api.py::TestWhatsappFlow::test_full_order_flow returns a value (str) instead of using assert. Not a functional issue — pytest PytestReturnNotNoneWarning only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py L377-397 detect_lang(): correctly implemented with ternary return contract ('ar' / 'en' / ''). Callers at L627-633 and L874-880 correctly guard the session-lang overwrite via `if detected == 'ar'` and `elif detected == 'en' and known_en`.

Both /api/whatsapp/message and run_bot_for_whatsapp share the same ~7-line detect-and-update block (L627-633 vs L874-880). Not a bug, but consider extracting into a helper `update_session_lang(session, text) -> str` to keep the two code paths from drifting in future changes.

rca_of_issue: Iteration 5 RCA re-verified: the fix applied to /app/backend/server.py exactly matches the recommendation from iteration_5.json.action_items[0]. detect_lang() (L377-397) now returns '' when the message carries no linguistic signal, and both callers (L627-633, L874-880) gate the session.lang overwrite behind an explicit `detected == 'ar'` OR (`detected == 'en' AND lower in GREET_EN|CHECKOUT_EN|CONFIRM_EN|CANCEL_EN`) check. Reproduction test case (POST 'مرحبا' → then POST 'add:<item_id>' on the same session_id) now correctly returns lang='ar' on the second call, and the full مرحبا → add → طلب → نعم flow ends with the Arabic receipt text 'تم تأكيد طلبك'. English keyword stickiness is symmetrically preserved (an 'add:<id>' after 'Hi' still returns 'Added').
